analyst_view.overall: Early view: Corum (9th) under Burak Yilmaz play in games full of goals (21 scored, 21 conceded) and were beaten 5-0 at home by Fenerbahce before the break. Kocaelispor (7th) under Selcuk Inan have the opposite profile, conceding only nine in eleven and taking seven points from their last three. Both play the weekend before, Corum at Basaksehir and Kocaelispor at home to Fenerbahce.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals and I lean slightly lower. Kocaelispor's games have averaged two goals and they won 2-0 at Eyupspor without conceding, and I expect their organisation to matter more than Corum's open style.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.3 corners. Corum should have more of the ball at home against a side happy to defend, which fits the split, so I stay with the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards. There are no reported suspensions or rivalries here, so I keep it near the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.6 shots and I lean a little lower. Kocaelispor limit opponents and take few shots themselves, so Corum's 14.1 looks like the ceiling rather than the middle.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target. Against a well-drilled Kocaelispor back line I expect Corum to struggle for clean chances, so slightly lower.
